audience: cafe and restaurant owners who run one or more Pawoon POS outlets

useCases.title: Find the best-selling products for a period
useCases.text: Read the sales per product, category and SKU for a date range. Check the product categories to group the results.

useCases.title: Review sales totals and payment methods
useCases.text: Read gross sales, discounts, refunds, net sales and taxes for a period. Read the number and amount of payments for each payment method.

useCases.title: Check stock in, stock out and sales per product
useCases.text: Read the beginning stock, stock in, stock out and sales of each product. Open one product to check its price and stock unit.

useCases.title: Look up a customer in the member list
useCases.text: List the customers with their contact details and member ID. Open one customer by its ID to read its details.

useCases.title: Review the promos and vouchers of an outlet
useCases.text: List the promos and vouchers of an outlet, with dates, codes and quotas. Read the use and amount of each promo in the promo report.

useCases.title: Trace the payments and items of one receipt
useCases.text: List the sales transactions, then read the payments and the items with their modifiers for one transaction.
